title: Nicolas Maduro shares first photos from prison since capture by US
text:
Captured Venezuelan dictator Nicolas Maduro shared photographs of himself from his Brooklyn prison over the weekend, calling the images a “small gift of love and hope” to his family and supporters.

“I send these photos as a small gift to all my grandchildren, to the boys and girls, and to all the good people who love us,” Maduro wrote on social media.
